_comment: Named gold items with fixed stats. spells = '+N to a spell' (spell id -> ranks). quest_only uniques never drop at random; quests hand them out with ItemGenerator.make_unique(id).

uniques.name: Greycloak's Walking Staff
uniques.flavor: Worn smooth by a hand that has walked every road. It was waiting for you.

uniques.name: The First Spoon
uniques.flavor: You moved it with your mind once. It has not forgotten.

uniques.name: Millbrook Hearthwarden
uniques.flavor: Stitched by every grandmother in the village, one row each.

uniques.name: Band of Seven Circles
uniques.flavor: Seven rings within the ring, and the innermost never stops turning.

uniques.name: Lens of Unmaking
uniques.flavor: Through it, every word has a second meaning, and the second one burns.

uniques.name: Stormcrown
uniques.flavor: The lightning that took the old man left this behind.

uniques.name: Ley-Walkers
uniques.flavor: They always know which way the power runs.
